newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it killed 50 rebel Kurds.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it killed 50 rebel Kurds.

text.p: Turkish security forces killed 50 Kurdish rebels on Sunday in southeastern Turkey, the regional governor's office said.
It said a security official also died in military operations near Yuksekova town backed by the air force against members of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK).
The statement gave no further details.
More than 26,000 people have been killed in the 12-year conflict between the armed forces and the PKK, fighting for self-rule in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
